topics.title: UHF RFID Frequencies, EPC Gen2 Protocols & Tag Selection
topics.objective: Select passive UHF tags (860-960 MHz) suited for metal, liquid, and cardboard inventory packaging.
topics.example: EPC Gen2 standard, ISO 18000-6C, On-Metal tag vs Standard Inlay tag.
topics.exercise: Select and specify tag inlay models for metal automotive parts vs plastic cosmetic bottles.

topics.title: Fixed Portal Readers & Dock Door Antennas
topics.objective: Position phased array portal antennas at loading docks to read full pallet inventories in under 2 seconds.
topics.example: ReaderConfig: 4 Circular Polarized Antennas at 30dBm power covering dock door 3.
topics.exercise: Design a portal antenna array configuration preventing stray reads from adjacent dock lanes.

topics.title: RFID Edge Middleware, De-Bouncing & LLRP Protocol
topics.objective: Filter duplicate tag read bursts using Low-Level Reader Protocol (LLRP) and time-window deduplication.
topics.example: LLRP RO_ACCESS_REPORT filtered: suppress duplicate EPC within 10-second sliding window.
topics.exercise: Write an edge filtering script collapsing 500 raw reads of 50 tags into a clean arrival inventory record.

topics.title: WMS Inventory Integration & Discrepancy Audits
topics.objective: Reconcile real-time physical pallet reads against expected Purchase Order bills of lading automatically.
topics.example: PO_Reconciliation: Expected 100 units, Scanned 98 -> Flag Discrepancy: Missing Item SKU-442.
topics.exercise: Build an automated audit function alerting fork-truck drivers of misplaced items on wrong storage racks.

topics.title: Mobile RFID Handheld Scanners & Rapid Cycle Counting
topics.objective: Execute high-speed inventory cycle counts across warehouse aisles in minutes rather than hours.
topics.example: Handheld scan rate: 800 tags/second with Geiger-counter locating mode.
topics.exercise: Design a guided mobile cycle counting workflow verifying rack inventory accuracy above 99.8%.
